# Blooms watercolor engine

Copied from the Blooms repo at commit `2eeb818` (2026-11-14) by `scripts/vendor-blooms.mjs`.

These files are unchanged copies. Do not edit them here: change Blooms and run the
script again, or tune the paint for the game in `watercolor.js`.

- `gl.js`
- `themes/watercolor/brush.js`
- `themes/watercolor/index.js`
- `themes/watercolor/params.js`
- `themes/watercolor/pigments.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/composite.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/flow.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/noise.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/paper.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/soak.js`
- `themes/watercolor/shaders/stamp.js`
